## Research Papers

### Respondent Covariates Can Lie: Evidence from Hierarchical Choice Models

Research on respondent covariates in hierarchical choice models, new-person predictive validation, fitted heterogeneity, and covariate-level regularization.

- Primary paper:
  https://github.com/jake-redanalytics/jake-redanalytics.github.io/tree/main/papers/respondent-covariates-can-lie

- SSRN:
  https://ssrn.com/abstract=7457138

#### Replication / Extension

**Improving Choice Model Accuracy Using Covariates Depends on What You Hold Out**

Extends the analysis using the public Sawtooth Software cruise choice dataset and compares same-respondent task holdouts with genuinely held-out respondents.

- Canonical publication on Medium:
  https://medium.com/@jake_61813/improving-choice-model-accuracy-using-covariates-depends-on-what-you-hold-out-0570f984d6f8

- Machine-readable GitHub version:
  https://jake-redanalytics.github.io/papers/respondent-covariates-can-lie/replication/
